_doc: Xankəndi (0.20.2, a short Qarabağ map): a 1.7 km two-lane loop through the town. The start on the east leg, the wide new avenue (the new four-storey buildings with arcades, the Victory square, Qarabağ University), the north bend past "Biz və bizim dağlar" on its hill, the west leg through the quarters of five-storey blocks and old stone houses, the south bend by the stadium. control: [x, y, z, full_width, theme 4 = forest].
